method: Select original Erosión Baja/Alta classes for each folder. Convert KML LineString to GeoJSON; preserve coordinates and all supplied fields. Missing cross-sensor fields remain absent. No rate calculation or temporal interpolation.
limitations: Periods are mission ranges reported by paper section 3.3.2, not per-transect acquisition dates.
KMZ does not contain individual imagery, confidence intervals, cell boundaries or property boundaries.
Different folders overlap; never add their counts as unique sites.
Omitted transects are not a classification of healthy coast.
Separate dataset license not identified; attribution and source link retained.
